title: Airfare of the Week: Turkish Airlines Economy Class Sydney – Warsaw from $1,254
body:
Australian Frequent Flyer
Australian Frequent Flyer - Tips, Tricks and Chat for Australian Frequent Flyers
Warsaw skyline. Photo: Adobe Stock.
Our newest Airfare of the Week belongs to Turkish Airlines, which has round-trip Economy Class fares from Sydney (SYD) to Warsaw (WAW) from $1,254.
This fare could be useful for those looking for a cheap full-service option to Europe, especially for those with Star Alliance Gold status. Also, this flight might allow you to complete the requirements of a Turkish Airlines status match .
Sample itinerary & pricing
Example pricing. Screenshot from Google Flights.
You can only book this fare directly on the Turkish Airlines website .
Interesting! The base fare is just $1! Screenshot from Turkish Airlines website.
Other cities in Europe including Stockholm, Budapest, Vienna and Zurich are priced similarly.
Note that fares and availability are subject to change. This fare may not be available by the time you read this article, and you might need to be flexible with travel dates. We recommend booking ASAP to avoid disappointment!
Travel dates & fare rules
Here are the details of this airfare:
Change fee: $348 before departure
Cancellation: Not allowed before departure or in case of no-show. A full refund is available within 24 hours of ticketing if the ticket was purchased at least 7 days before scheduled departure.
Maximum stay of 12 months
Four stopovers allowed at USD70 (~AU$98) each. Maximum five days per stopover.
Open-jaws with other European ports are allowed
On-board product
Turkish Airlines flies its Airbus A350 aircraft to Sydney. The flight to Istanbul currently operates as a one-stop via Kuala Lumpur, but will shift to Singapore from 26th October 2026. AFF has previously reviewed the product and it is a great experience overall.
Turkish Airlines A350-900 Economy Class. Photo: Matt Graham.
The onward flights to Warsaw on either an Airbus A320 or A321neo aircraft.
Earning points with this airfare
This fare books into “U” class. While Turkish Airlines is a member of Star Alliance, this fare class only earns points under the Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles program.
The flights earn at least 2,534 Miles and an equivalent amount of Status Miles each way.
